1  JUDGMENT AND ORDER DATED 16.04.2014 PASSED BY THE  SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC, SINDAGI IN LAC  NO.02/2010.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS  DAY, JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-K:6847  MFA No. 200809 of 2018 CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE N.S.SANJAY GOWDA  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE N.S.SANJAY GOWDA)
This appeal is in relation to the determination of compensation in respect of Sy.No.162 of Bantanur village which is situate in Sindagi taluk of Vijayapur district.
2. The land in Sy.No.162 was the subject matter of a notification issued under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act on 21.03.1991.
3. Pursuant to a declaration, an award was passed on 30.09.1992 offering a sum of `5,000/- per acre by the Land Acquisition Officer.
The land loser being dissatisfied sought for reference and the Reference Court by the impugned order dated 16.04.2014 has enhanced compensation of `1,10,000/- per acre.

4. The Reference Court in order to arrive at the sum of `1,10,000/- per acre has basically relied upon two judgments passed by this Court i.e., MFA No.2020/2005 which was in relation to lands notified in Bommanjogi NC: 2024:KHC-K:6847 village of Sindagi taluk situated in the same taluka and which was notified under the preliminary notification dated 08.01.1996.

The other judgment relied upon by the reference Court was the decision rendered by this Court in MFA No.5387/2002 in which the lands belonging to Dammur village, Aland Taluk was acquired under a notification dated 18.09.1997 was involved.

5. The Government, however, is in appeal contending that the reliance on the judgment Ex.P.7 i.e.,
MFA No.2020/2005, though of the same taluka could not have been the criteria since the notification concerning those lands was dated 08.01.1996, whereas in the instant case the notification related to the year 1991.
6.

A perusal of Ex.P.7 does indicate that this Court took into consideration the judgment passed in respect of Bommanjogi village in Sindagi taluk rendered in MFA No.5387/2002 to arrive at the figure of `1,09,800/- per acre in respect of dry land and `1,60,000/- for wetland.

NC: 2024:KHC-K:6847 The Special Land vs Shankrappa on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88815164/
2 7.
In my view, the said sum can be taken as the basis for determining the compensation however by deescalating the said amount by 5% every year till 1991.

Consequently, the compensation payable for the lands involved in this appeal which were notified in year 1991 by applying a de-escalation at the rate of 5% compounded annually would be `85,115/-.
8.
Consequently, the impugned award is modified and it is held that the claimant will be entitled to sum `85,115/- along with all statutory benefits.
The appeal is accordingly allowed in part.

Sd/-
(N.S.SANJAY GOWDA) JUDGE SN The Special Land vs Shankrappa on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88815164/
